summary.result: Bio swales focused on the improvement of built environments, rain gardens connected aesthetic benefits, porous pavers focused community revitalization and mitigating disasters, curb cuts connected the improvement of the pedestrian environment, and green roofs suggested providing open space.
summary.background: The purpose of this study is to identify the type of community benefits and relative focus of green infrastructure techniques, such as bio swales, rain gardens, porous pavers, curb cuts, and green roofs.
